expected.text: The handoff key is the project slug alone, so two directories whose names differ only in punctuation (my_app and my-app) share one handoff.
parse_name splits on '-', which a slug can contain, so a handoff for repo-2 can parse as a tagged handoff of repo.
When the move into used/ fails, the loaded handoff file is deleted, so the part past the injected cut is lost.
